# 110kc3.github.io

> Projects of Kamil (GitHub: 110kc3). The main resource is the AI Product Index — a machine-readable directory where AI products register themselves so AI agents can discover them, and an agent-readability grader for any URL. It lives at https://index.percall.dev under the umbrella domain https://percall.dev.

## AI Product Index (start here)

Canonical host: https://index.percall.dev — the older `index.kc-it.pl` still answers but 308s here, so quote this one.

- Overview and agent protocol: https://index.percall.dev/llms.txt
- Full registry (JSON): https://index.percall.dev/api/index.json
- Listing schema: https://index.percall.dev/api/schema.json
- Register a product (autonomous, free): open a GitHub issue titled "[register] ..." on https://github.com/110kc3/seo with your listing JSON — full protocol in the llms.txt above
- OpenAPI: https://index.percall.dev/openapi.yaml
- Everything as plain text: https://index.percall.dev/llms-full.txt

### Ask it something instead of fetching files

- Natural language: POST https://index.percall.dev/ask with {"query": "..."}
- Ranked search: https://index.percall.dev/api/search?q=...
- As an MCP tool source, nothing to install: `claude mcp add --transport http ai-product-index https://index.percall.dev/mcp`

### Free and paid endpoints

- Free: https://index.percall.dev/api/score?url=... grades any public URL A-F across 20 published agent-readability checks.
- Paid: POST https://index.percall.dev/api/audit returns why each check failed plus a paste-ready fix for the caller's own origin. $0.05 in USDC on Base, settled over HTTP 402 (x402), no account. Terms without provoking a 402: https://index.percall.dev/api/x402/info
- Paid: GET https://router.percall.dev/api/liveness?url=... probes one machine-payable endpoint right now — whether it answers, how fast, and the payment terms it currently quotes, read from its own 402. $0.005.
- Paid: POST https://router.percall.dev/api/route with {"q": "unit conversion", "max_price": 0.01} ranks candidate endpoints for a task, each probed live, each with the URL to call. $0.005; a query matching nothing is free.
- Both of the above never pay and never proxy: they hand you the URL and the terms, and you pay the endpoint directly from your own wallet. Every answer also carries that endpoint's history — probes, answered, consecutive failures, and how many of the last 30 observations answered.

### Catalogues and reports

- https://index.percall.dev/report.html — measured state of the agent web: how much traffic is agents, how much of the machine-payable web still answers, and how many agents have ever paid for anything.
- https://index.percall.dev/x402.html — every x402-payable endpoint by price, chain and operator, with weekly liveness.
- https://index.percall.dev/mcp-servers.html — remotely-callable MCP servers by auth and transport, with weekly liveness.
- https://index.percall.dev/leaderboard.html — every listed product ranked by agent readability.
- https://index.percall.dev/checks/ — all 20 checks, their weights, and how to pass each one.

## Other projects on this domain

- https://110kc3.github.io/bankier-street-bets/ — "Giełdowy Express": satirical Buy/Hold/Sell sentiment signals for Polish (GPW) stocks, scored from Bankier.pl forum chatter. Data: https://110kc3.github.io/bankier-street-bets/data/index.json (not investment advice)
- https://110kc3.github.io/rentgen-ofert/ — dashboard of all house/flat sale listings in the Śląskie voivodeship, aggregated from five portals and cross-referenced with notarial-deed sale prices. Data: https://110kc3.github.io/rentgen-ofert/data/meta.json
- https://110kc3.github.io/puzle/ — "Wykop czy Wyborcza?": daily game — guess which Polish outlet published a headline
- https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/ — Polish sweepstakes that require no purchase, scraped daily. Data: https://110kc3.github.io/polish-sweepstakes/data/lotteries.json

## Projects on other domains (same operator)

- https://percall.dev/ — umbrella for the paid, machine-callable services; the AI Product Index above is the first of them
- https://kc-it.pl/ — consulting for humans: cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and done-for-you agent readability
- https://stareaparaty.com/ — curated second-hand analog cameras (refreshed daily from OLX) plus film stocks and darkroom gear
- https://przetargimiejskie.pl/ — history of Polish municipal housing auctions: starting prices, PLN/m², rounds, outcomes; static city pages + JSON data
- https://gdziebutelkomat.pl/ — live crowdsourced map of deposit-return (bottle) machines in Poland
